Powering America's Future with Homegrown Energy
Who We Are
Unleashing American Energy
Marquis has a 50-year-long history of driving innovation in American biofuel production, strengthening rural economies, and securing our nation’s energy future. As a multi-generational, family-owned business, Marquis is committed to advancing homegrown energy that supports American farmers, promotes domestic energy security, and creates good-paying jobs in our local communities.

Section 45Z: Clean Fuel Production Credit
Biofuels
Marquis Energy produces more than 395 million gallons of high-octane, high-performance renewable ethanol fuel per year, as well as Distillers Dried Grains With Solubles (DDGS) and Distillers Corn Oil (DCO).
Proteins & Animal Feed
To combat the world’s protein shortage, Marquis isolates the protein, fat and fiber parts of corn to produce a traditional Dried Distillers Grains and Solubles (DDGS) animal feed product.
Grain Procurement
Marquis Grain partners with local growers and elevators to procure corn for ethanol production and market Dried Distillers Grains and Solubles (DDGS) to customers around the world.
Technology
Created by producers for producers in order to maximize the value in each kernel of corn, the Marquis ProCap technology is designed to increase oil yield, decrease energy and increase revenue.
Feed & Fuel Marketing
Marquis has more than 40 years of experience buying and marketing agriculture products. By combining vertical integration with a robust technical team, we sell ethanol and feed products with various specifications for a broad range of global markets.
Contract Manufacturing
Marquis XT provides custom manufacturing solutions, including private label, contract manufacturing, on-site formulation and bulk industrial ethanol.
Industrial & USP Alcohol
Marquis leverages our logistics advantages and alcohol production expertise to provide an array of high-quality industrial and USP alcohol options. We can provide on-site technical support and have the global reach to participate in worldwide markets.
Logistics & Infrastructure
The Marquis Industrial Complex in Hennepin, Illinois, is strategically located with global distribution infrastructure to propel growth. Marquis also has a site in Necedah, Wisconsin, which is similarly positioned for distribution and growth.
Section 45Z: Clean Fuel Production Credit
As we await additional federal guidance on 45Z, we are investing in our growers’ operations by paying for a third-party (Verdova) verified Carbon Intensity (CI) score on our growers’ existing farm operations.
Leading In American Energy Innovation
Through American-made energy, Marquis promotes domestic manufacturing and strengthens U.S. agriculture, aviation, and marine transportation industries. Strategically located on the Mt. Simon geological formation, the Marquis Industrial Complex has the capacity to store over 100 million tons of carbon dioxide, using carbon capture technology, reinforcing America’s leadership in energy innovation.
